versions.changelog: The API key is now optional to load this skill; with no key, a pointer leads to a temporary free key with no signup and a link the user opens to keep it.
Clarifies disclosure-date windows, partial-slice free previews, the member directory for name lookups, and rate-limit backoff.
Fix: documents limit, offset and totalCount on the recent-trades feed, which is paged. One call is one page, so wide windows must be paged before counting or ranking.
Removes the npx execution path and declares permissions.
AGENTS coupon; CLI rung (npx sentisense congress, market-wide and one ticker); member-page facts re-derived live (520 of 542 fit one page, 22 exceed it); fixed output template for the weekly feed
Clarify that totalCount sits on the response envelope rather than inside data, and note that most members fit in a single page.
Convergence guidance now includes insider Form 4 activity; sharper wording on keyless previews.
Description now carries the trigger phrases callers actually search for.
Initial release: congressional STOCK Act trades from official House Clerk and Senate eFD filings (recent trades, per-ticker history, most-active members, per-member profile).
